title: Courageous Business Connect networking meeting
seo_title: Courageous Business Connect Networking in Springfield, MO
description: This is a business networking meeting where like-minded business people build relationships and pass referrals to keep money local. It is the weekly meeting for the Courageous Success Team; members can visit other meetings, and non-members can visit three times to decide whether to join a Success Team. It takes place on December 3, 2026, Time TBD, at Travellers House Coffee & Tea, 2151 W Republic Rd in Springfield, Missouri.
